name: agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene
body:
Reconciliation / provenance (spec-writer, `agent-builder-agents-md` change-set).

SOURCE: make the distributed `agent-builder` own `AGENTS.md` hygiene — a main-write grant on the repo-root `AGENTS.md`; ensure `AGENTS.md` carries NOTHING about the change-set flow (the flow is owned solely and immutably by the distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt) and never contradicts the distributed-agent rules; the agent-builder AUDITS `AGENTS.md` and REMOVES any flow content it finds, never adding a reference/pointer to the navigator and never restating the flow; it acts non-destructively (preserve all repo-specific content); it acts only when an `AGENTS.md` exists; and the rule is UNIVERSAL (every apg project — the apg repo's `build-implementer` also touching `AGENTS.md` is a LOCAL arrangement, not a universal rule).

REFINEMENT [with user]. The earlier wording — "must not duplicate … remove or repoint it at the navigator … AGENTS.md references the navigator; it never re-specifies the process" — is REPLACED. `codebase-navigator.md` is the IMMUTABLE source of truth for the change-set flow, and `AGENTS.md` must contain NOTHING about the flow at all: not a duplicate, not a summary, and NOT even a reference/pointer to the navigator. The agent-builder keeps its `AGENTS.md` edit grant and AUDITS the guide for consistency, removing ANY flow content it finds; it must NOT add a reference/pointer and must not restate the flow.

VERIFIED against the branch graph: the code surface edited by THIS hygiene requirement resolves — `File {fqn:'opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md', code_type:'docs'}` — so its `implemented-by` edge resolves and NO planned Implementation node is needed. `AGENTS.md` is a scanned `docs` File but is NOT edited by this hygiene requirement (consumer artifact). `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` is NOT edited BY THIS HYGIENE REQUIREMENT — but it IS edited by the SIBLING requirement `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence` (see SIBLING REQUIREMENT below); the two requirements have different edited files and different `implemented-by` targets. The existing `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` already enumerates the file's surfaces (a)-(d) and is `implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`; the existing `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` and `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` named the agent-builder's main-write surface as `.opencode/agents/**` PLUS `opencode.json`.

DECISION — narrow new component, coverage 1:1. Added `solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` whose ONLY `implemented-by` target is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`, so the new requirement's derived solution coverage maps 1:1 to the one edited file. Two components sharing one code target is established practice in this tree (`solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` / `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`). `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` is AMENDED to add the surface (e) for consistency, but the new narrow component is what the coverage check resolves through.

DECISION — main-write accounting. The source phrased the new count as "four paths under carve-out 1". Read consistently, the correct accounting is FOUR main-write paths ACROSS the two carve-outs — `.opencode/agents/**`, the `opencode.json` agent→model map, the repo-root `AGENTS.md`, and the release-agent's artefact set — with carve-out 1 covering THREE of them and the carve-out COUNT staying TWO. This is the reading recorded in the amended `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` and in the new constraint.

Added:
- `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` (feature `agent-builder-agents-md`) — the grant, non-contradiction, nothing-about-the-flow (audit-and-remove), non-destructive, only-when-present and universality rules.
- `requirements.constraint.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` (`attaches-to` the requirement) — the law form: nothing-about-the-flow / audit-and-remove, non-destructive merge, only-when-present, the four-paths/two-carve-outs accounting, universality.
- `domain.entity.repo-agent-guide-surface` (kind `entity`) — the guide's hygiene contract as a concept, distinct from `agent-scaffold-flow` and `graph-first-navigation`.
- `solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` — the narrow owner, `implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` ONLY.

Amended in place (edge-preserving `apg_node update`):
- `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` — carve-out 1 now names the repo-root `AGENTS.md` as a third path; the count line reads FOUR main-write paths across two carve-outs, carve-out COUNT still TWO.
- `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` — the agent-builder's main-write grants now name `.opencode/agents/**` AND the `opencode.json` agent→model map AND the repo-root `AGENTS.md`; its acceptance is updated to match, and it now says `AGENTS.md` carries nothing about the flow.
- `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` — surfaces (a) and (c) now include the `AGENTS.md` frontmatter grant, and surface (e) states the AGENTS.md hygiene responsibility (nothing-about-the-flow / audit-and-remove).
- `domain.entity.repo-agent-guide-surface` — clause (b) now states the guide carries NOTHING about the flow and the agent-builder never adds a reference/pointer.

SIBLING REQUIREMENT (navigator surface). THIS change-set ALSO includes `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence` (law `requirements.constraint.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence`, `requirements.note.navigator-agent-builder-surface-reconciliation`), which edits the OTHER product-source file `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` via `solution.component.navigator-agent-builder-surface`. That requirement is orthogonal to hygiene: it makes the navigator prompt accurately account for the agent-builder's main-write surface (reference, do not restate). The change-set therefore edits TWO product-source files, one per requirement, each with its own narrow component and 1:1 coverage.

SPINE (this hygiene requirement). `requirements.user.navigator-agent ⊃ requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene —drives→ domain.entity.repo-agent-guide-surface —realised-by→ solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene —implemented-by→ opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`.

PLAN CONSEQUENCE (for the plan-writer). For THIS HYGIENE requirement, satisfy ONLY `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`; the single edited file is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. That "satisfy ONLY" restraint is scoped to this hygiene requirement — the change-set ALSO carries `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence`, whose sole edited file is `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (see the sibling requirement above and `requirements.note.navigator-agent-builder-surface-reconciliation`). Do NOT declare `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow`, `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`, `requirements.requirement.navigator-staged-flow`, `requirements.requirement.code-writer-worktree-only-writes` or `requirements.requirement.navigator-no-unguarded-main-git` satisfied: each reaches a component whose `implemented-by` targets (`AGENTS.md`, tests, or untouched code) this change-set does NOT edit, and `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` derives solution coverage from satisfied requirements' spine.

NON-GOALS. `AGENTS.md` and the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are NOT edited by this hygiene requirement. `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow` is deliberately left as the scaffold→commit→rebase flow owner (its surface enumeration is supplemented, not contradicted, by the amended constraint). The apg repo's own `AGENTS.md` still carries process prose; refreshing it is the post-RELEASE agent-builder follow-up, never a change-set task. The `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` edit is owned by `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence`, not by this requirement.

OPEN QUESTIONS.
1. NAVIGATOR PROMPT — RESOLVED. The navigator-surface widening IS now in this change-set: `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence` (with law `requirements.constraint.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence`) edits `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, and `requirements.note.navigator-agent-builder-surface-reconciliation` records it. It is no longer deferred to a future change-set.
2. UNIVERSAL-vs-LOCAL: the apg repo's `build-implementer` also touching `AGENTS.md` is modelled as a local arrangement only; no spec node encodes it. Confirm reviewers agree the universal law reads cleanly without naming `build-implementer`.
3. The `AGENTS.md` guide prose in the apg repo (e.g. its step-7 statement that the agent-builder's sole write surface is `.opencode/agents/**`) is stale relative to the FOUR-path accounting; refreshing it is the post-release follow-up noted above.
